lines.text: Lesson twelve: margin and leverage. Why small price moves can feel very big.
lines.say: Lesson twelve: margin and leverage. Why small price moves can feel very big.

lines.text: Two traders each put 100 USDT into the same BTC futures trade.
lines.say: Two traders each put one hundred U-S-D-T into the same B-T-C futures trade.

lines.text: BTC rises 2%. Trader A gains 2 USDT. Trader B gains 20 USDT.
lines.say: B-T-C rises two percent. Trader A gains two U-S-D-T. Trader B gains twenty U-S-D-T.

lines.text: Then BTC falls to 2% below the start. A loses 2. B loses 20.
lines.say: Then B-T-C falls to two percent below the start. A loses two. B loses twenty.

lines.text: Same coin, same move. What made the difference? Leverage.
lines.say: Same coin, same move. What made the difference? Leverage.

lines.text: First word: margin. Initial margin is the money you set aside to open a futures position.
lines.say: First word: margin. Initial margin is the money you set aside to open a futures position.

lines.text: Your futures wallet holds 500 USDT. You lock 100 USDT as margin. 400 stays free.
lines.say: Your futures wallet holds five hundred U-S-D-T. You lock one hundred U-S-D-T as margin. Four hundred stays free.

lines.text: Think of a deposit on a rented car. Any damage comes out of that deposit.
lines.say: Think of a deposit on a rented car. Any damage comes out of that deposit.

lines.text: Next: notional exposure. That's the full value of the position, in USDT.
lines.say: Next: notional exposure. That's the full value of the position, in U-S-D-T.

lines.text: With 100 USDT of margin, you could hold a position worth 1,000 USDT.
lines.say: With one hundred U-S-D-T of margin, you could hold a position worth one thousand U-S-D-T.

lines.text: Price moves act on the full 1,000 USDT, not just on your 100.
lines.say: Price moves act on the full one thousand U-S-D-T, not just on your one hundred.

lines.text: Leverage is how many times bigger the position is than your margin.
lines.say: Leverage is how many times bigger the position is than your margin.

lines.text: At 1x, 100 USDT of margin holds 100 of notional. At 3x, 300. At 10x, 1,000.
lines.say: At one ex, one hundred U-S-D-T of margin holds one hundred of notional. At three ex, three hundred. At ten ex, one thousand.

lines.text: So notional is roughly margin times leverage. Your 100 USDT does not change.
lines.say: So notional is roughly margin times leverage. Your one hundred U-S-D-T does not change.

lines.text: Leverage is like a magnifying glass. It enlarges every move, good and bad.
lines.say: Leverage is like a magnifying glass. It enlarges every move, good and bad.

lines.text: Now one price path, three ways. Each trader is long with 100 USDT of margin.
lines.say: Now one price path, three ways. Each trader is long with one hundred U-S-D-T of margin.

lines.text: BTC rises 2%, to 61,200. 1x makes 2 USDT. 3x makes 6. 10x makes 20.
lines.say: B-T-C rises two percent, to sixty-one thousand two hundred. One ex makes two U-S-D-T. Three ex makes six. Ten ex makes twenty.

lines.text: Then it falls to 58,800, 2% below the start. Now 1x loses 2, 3x loses 6, 10x loses 20.
lines.say: Then it falls to fifty-eight thousand eight hundred, two percent below the start. Now one ex loses two, three ex loses six, ten ex loses twenty.

lines.text: The market moved the same for all three. Leverage only changed the size of the result.
lines.say: The market moved the same for all three. Leverage only changed the size of the result.

lines.text: A worked example. Gross PnL is about notional times the signed percentage move.
lines.say: A worked example. Gross P and L is about notional times the signed percentage move.

lines.text: 1,000 USDT times minus 2% is minus 20 USDT, before fees and funding.
lines.say: One thousand U-S-D-T times minus two percent is minus twenty U-S-D-T, before fees and funding.

lines.text: Divide by your margin: minus 20 over 100 is minus 20%.
lines.say: Divide by your margin: minus twenty over one hundred is minus twenty percent.

lines.text: A 2% price move became 20% of your money.
lines.say: A two percent price move became twenty percent of your money.

lines.text: This works in both directions. Say BTC falls 10%.
lines.say: This works in both directions. Say B-T-C falls ten percent.

lines.text: At 1x, you lose 10 USDT, 10% of your margin. At 10x, you lose 100 USDT: all of it, on paper.
lines.say: At one ex, you lose ten U-S-D-T, ten percent of your margin. At ten ex, you lose one hundred U-S-D-T: all of it, on paper.

lines.text: In reality, the exchange closes the position before that point. That's liquidation.
lines.say: In reality, the exchange closes the position before that point. That's liquidation.

lines.text: Where exactly depends on its rules and costs.
lines.say: Where exactly depends on its rules and costs.

lines.text: Maintenance margin is the minimum the exchange needs to keep your position open.
lines.say: Maintenance margin is the minimum the exchange needs to keep your position open.

lines.text: Your margin balance is your margin plus any open profit or loss. Losses push it down.
lines.say: Your margin balance is your margin plus any open profit or loss. Losses push it down.

lines.text: Fall to the maintenance level, and the exchange can close the position. Its rules set the level.
lines.say: Fall to the maintenance level, and the exchange can close the position. Its rules set the level.

lines.text: You also choose a margin mode: isolated or cross.
lines.say: You also choose a margin mode: isolated or cross.

lines.text: Isolated: losses on that position generally stay within the margin you gave it.
lines.say: Isolated: losses on that position generally stay within the margin you gave it.

lines.text: Like a separate envelope of cash. The other 400 USDT is not touched by it.
lines.say: Like a separate envelope of cash. The other four hundred U-S-D-T is not touched by it.

lines.text: Cross: your whole futures balance backs your positions. One loss can reach far more.
lines.say: Cross: your whole futures balance backs your positions. One loss can reach far more.

lines.text: Neither mode is safe. They decide how far a loss can reach.
lines.say: Neither mode is safe. They decide how far a loss can reach.

lines.text: A common mistake: thinking leverage is free extra money.
lines.say: A common mistake: thinking leverage is free extra money.

lines.text: It isn't. It's extra exposure. Losses on the full 1,000 come out of your 100.
lines.say: It isn't. It's extra exposure. Losses on the full one thousand come out of your one hundred.

lines.text: And no leverage number is safe. Lower leverage only means smaller swings.
lines.say: And no leverage number is safe. Lower leverage only means smaller swings.

lines.text: Your turn. Margin 50 USDT, 5x, long. BTC rises 4%. Find the notional, the PnL and the % of margin.
lines.say: Your turn. Margin fifty U-S-D-T, five ex, long. B-T-C rises four percent. Find the notional, the P and L and the percent of margin.

lines.text: Notional: 50 times 5 is 250 USDT. PnL: 250 times 4% is plus 10 USDT.
lines.say: Notional: fifty times five is two hundred fifty U-S-D-T. P and L: two hundred fifty times four percent is plus ten U-S-D-T.

lines.text: That's 20% of your margin. Had BTC fallen 4%, it would be minus 10 USDT.
lines.say: That's twenty percent of your margin. Had B-T-C fallen four percent, it would be minus ten U-S-D-T.

lines.text: Did you get it? Well done.
lines.say: Did you get it? Well done.

lines.text: Before you go further, know the risks.
lines.say: Before you go further, know the risks.

lines.text: Leverage magnifies losses just as much as gains.
lines.say: Leverage magnifies losses just as much as gains.

lines.text: If losses eat your margin, the exchange can close your position. More on that next lesson.
lines.say: If losses eat your margin, the exchange can close your position. More on that next lesson.

lines.text: Fees and funding are charged on the notional, so they grow with leverage.
lines.say: Fees and funding are charged on the notional, so they grow with leverage.

lines.text: There is no safe leverage. And you can always choose WAIT, or no trade.
lines.say: There is no safe leverage. And you can always choose wait, or no trade.

lines.text: Let's recap.
lines.say: Let's recap.

lines.text: Notional is about margin times leverage.
lines.say: Notional is about margin times leverage.

lines.text: Gross PnL is about notional times the signed move, before fees.
lines.say: Gross P and L is about notional times the signed move, before fees.

lines.text: Leverage magnifies gains and losses alike. No leverage is safe.
lines.say: Leverage magnifies gains and losses alike. No leverage is safe.

lines.text: Check yourself: 100 USDT of margin at 10x. BTC falls 3%. What's the PnL?
lines.say: Check yourself: one hundred U-S-D-T of margin at ten ex. B-T-C falls three percent. What's the P and L?

lines.text: Minus 30 USDT, which is 30% of your margin.
lines.say: Minus thirty U-S-D-T, which is thirty percent of your margin.

lines.text: Next up, T13: liquidation, funding and futures risks. See you there!
lines.say: Next up, T thirteen: liquidation, funding and futures risks. See you there!
